title: Optimization Modpack For Zalith By VenzzzC5
body:
# ⚡ ZALITH BOOST – Mobile Performance Modpack

## ✨ About
Zalith Boost is a Minecraft modpack designed specifically for mobile players, especially Zalith users.  
It focuses on improving performance to make your game smoother, lighter, and less laggy without changing the core gameplay.

## 🚀 Main Goal
"Less lag. More play."

## 🔥 Features
- 📱 Optimized for mobile devices  
- ⚡ More stable FPS & better performance  
- 🧩 Lightweight and efficient mods  
- 🎮 Vanilla-friendly gameplay improvements  
- 🔧 Pre-configured settings (no setup needed)  

## 🎮 Why use this modpack?
- Perfect for low-end to mid-range devices  
- Reduces lag and stuttering significantly  
- Simple and easy to use, just install and play  

## ⚙️ Compatibility
- Minecraft: 1.20.1
- Loader: Fabric Loader  
- Platform: Mobile and PC (Zalith supported)  

## 📦 Installation
1. Install the required loader  
2. Download this modpack  
3. Place it into your mods folder or import it  
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy 🚀  

## ⚠️ Notes
- Updates will be released regularly  
- Some features may change in future versions  

## ❤️ Support
Feel free to download and share this modpack to support the project.  
More support = more updates and better features in the future.

## 🌟 Final Words
Hope this modpack gives you a smoother, faster, and more enjoyable Minecraft experience 😊
